summary: Make every canonical public user page guest-open by default. Authentication enhances the public experience with tier-, membership-, role- and capability-scoped features instead of replacing the public page with a login or permission wall.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly confirmed that user pages must be open to everyone by default and instructed EKODI to adopt this as a highest-level rule, while allowing the signed-in experience to change by membership tier and role.
adds: guest-open default for canonical public user pages
safe public projection preserved before and after authentication
explicit classification requirement for private/closed exceptions
validators preventing guest-hidden controls from replacing canonical public roots
rollback: Revert constitution v1.17.0, the PUBLIC-USER-SURFACE-001 machine policy, Workspace visibility guard changes, Shell guest-open guard and related validators to v1.16.0. Do not change workspace_id, membership records, private data, domains or administrator routes during rollback.
